info.title: UnfoldX public API
info.summary: Delegate explainer videos to the UnfoldX main agent and follow them to the finished film.
info.description:
The single contract for the `unfoldx` CLI, the `unfoldx-mcp` server and any other client.

* Every response is the `unfoldx.v2` envelope: `data` when `ok` is true, `error` otherwise.
  Responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.
* `error.type` is a closed set that clients map to exit codes; `error.code` is the precise reason.
* Public ids only: workspace ids, `run_…`, `<run_id>.video|cover`, `mat_…`, `cred_…`.
* A workspace is one main-agent conversation; a run is one message to it.
* Writes run through the same services as the web. `POST /v2/runs` needs an `Idempotency-Key`
  (the client's command id): the same key and body return the same run, a changed body is 409.
* A route card is answered on the user's behalf only within the credential's budget; above it the
  answer is `needs_input/approval_required` with the `approval_url` where the user confirms.
* Publishing requires explicit publish:confirm scope and a current publish card.
* Clients name themselves on every request with `X-Unfoldx-Client` (`cli` or `mcp`,
  `#/components/parameters/UnfoldxClient`).

get.summary: The run a command id started (for a client that lost the response). Scope `runs:read`.

post.summary: Answer the run's route, storyboard or publish card. Scope `runs:answer` (publish cards also `publish:confirm`). A route whose hold exceeds the credential's per-run cap, or the last 24 hours' auto-approved holds plus this one exceed the daily cap, is 409 `needs_input/approval_required` with `details.approval_url`; nothing is held and the card stays open on the web.
Stop the run; repeating it, or cancelling a finished run, returns its current state. Scope `runs:cancel`.
A ten-minute signed form to POST one file straight to object storage under the user's own key. Scope `materials:write`. Then call `/v2/materials/{id}/complete`.

get.description: Read an owned material. Requires materials:read.

Events after a cursor. `seq` increases but is not contiguous; dedupe by `seq`.
The server answers at once; clients poll. Scope `runs:read`.
Open confirmation cards, oldest first. Scope `runs:read`.
The film's artifacts. `ready` is false until the run completes; earlier films are never returned. Scope `runs:read`.

film.description: the film a confirmation publishes; if a newer film has been made since, the answer is 409 and the agent must ask again

idempotent_replay.description: true when this command id had already started the run

Answer.description: Use the question answer_schema for card-specific choices and answer_examples for valid actions.

published_url.description: Validated platform-returned publication link, or null. Acceptance is not moderation approval or proof of public visibility.

FilmDuration.description: Measured duration is a soft-target fact. The caller decides whether to revise; deviation never fails the job.

unfoldx_work_export.description: Download a work as video, cover, exact subtitles, storyboard, transcript, mixed audio or ZIP. Uses local ffmpeg only for derived audio; no invented subtitle times.
